subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: `live_preview` was removed from the destructuring of all public functions (getEntry, getSingleEntry, getAllContentTypeEntries, findSingletonEntry, getSingletonEntry) and from their createContentTypeQuery/createContentTypeEntryQuery calls. This makes the live_preview handling in setCommonConfig (lines 110-112) dead code — preview context can never reach setCommonConfig because no caller forwards it. AC#3 requires that preview context 'can flow through to Contentstack queries in setCommonConfig'. The diff actively removes the forwarding that previously existed, which is a regression.
issues.suggestedFix: Restore `live_preview` to the destructuring of each public function and pass it through to createContentTypeQuery/createContentTypeEntryQuery calls, e.g. in getEntry: destructure `live_preview` from IContentstackGetEntry and include it in the factory.createContentTypeQuery({ ... live_preview }) call. Do the same for getSingleEntry, getAllContentTypeEntries, findSingletonEntry, and getSingletonEntry.

issues.description: `as any` on the live_preview block in options has no explanatory comment. The previous code had a comment explaining that the SDK's TypeScript types declare `live_preview.management_token` but the delivery SDK reads `preview_token`. This comment was removed, violating the TypeScript strict compliance criterion requiring explanatory comments for any usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Add an inline comment explaining why `as any` is needed, e.g.: `// SDK types declare management_token but delivery SDK reads preview_token` before the `as any` cast, or better yet cast to the IContentstackLivePreviewContext interface.

issues.description: The code uses `query.addQuery("live_preview", ...)` but the Contentstack delivery SDK's Query class may not have an `addQuery` method. The previous implementation used `query.addParam("live_preview", ...)`. If `addQuery` does not exist on the SDK's Query type, this will throw at runtime when live_preview is forwarded.
issues.suggestedFix: Verify that `addQuery` exists on the Contentstack SDK's Query class. If it does not, revert to using `addParam` or the SDK's documented method for adding custom query parameters for live preview.

issues.description: `as any` on `live_preview.preview_hash as any` lacks an explanatory comment, violating TypeScript strict compliance criteria.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a brief comment explaining the cast, or properly type the addQuery/addParam parameter.

issues.description: The contentstack mock does not include an `addQuery` method. If live_preview forwarding were exercised in tests (once the blocker is fixed and live_preview is actually forwarded), the mock would need an `addQuery` spy to verify the behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `addQuery: jest.fn().mockReturnThis()` to the Stack mock object.
